column1:
Reduce direct greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions by 10% on a per unit basis1 by 
2020 from 2010 levels.
column2:
In 2014, our GHG emissions were down 22% on a per unit basis compared to 
2010 levels, and with continued investment in emissions reducing initiatives,  
we believe we are on track to reach this goal.

column1: Reduce water use on a per unit basis below 2010 levels by 2020.
column2:
Our per unit water usage decreased by 9% in 2014 compared to 2013 levels, and 
with continued investments in water conservation, we believe we will be able to 
meet our 2020 goal.

column1: Achieve cumulative energy savings of 4 billion kWh from 2012 to 2020.
column2:
We continued to invest in energy conservation projects during 2014, investing 
$30 million and achieving energy savings of 211 million kWh for a total 
cumulative energy savings of 1.6 billion kWh. Taking into account other planned 
investments, we are on track to reach our goal.

column1: Achieve zero hazardous waste to landfill by 2020.
column2:
In 2014, we sent 0% of our hazardous waste generated to landfill, and are on 
track toward achieving our 2020 goal.

column1: Achieve 90% non-hazardous waste recycle rate by 2020.
column2:
We recycled 86% of our non-hazardous waste generated in 2014, and are on 
track to meet our 2020 goal.

column1:
Reduce hazardous waste generation by 10% on a per unit basis1 by 2020 from 
2010 levels.
column2:
Based on our calculations and projections, we do not believe we will be able 
to achieve our 2020 goal. We have decided to eliminate this goal, and focus on 
reducing the amount of hazardous waste we send to landfill.

column1:
Implement an enhanced green chemistry screening and selection process for 
100% of new chemicals and gases by 2020.
column2:
We continue to make progress toward our green chemistry screening and 
selection process for 100% of new chemicals and gases, and believe we will be 
able to achieve our 2020 goal.

column1:
Design all new buildings to a minimum LEED* Silver certification between 2010 
and 2020.
column2:
We successfully designed all new buildings to a minimum LEED* Silver 
certification, and have revised the goal to design all new buildings to a minimum 
LEED* Gold certification level between 2015 and 2020.

column1:
Increase the energy efficiency of notebook computers and data center products 
25x by 2020 from 2010 levels.2
column2:
We are working with industry partners to accomplish this aggressive goal, and 
believe we are on track to achieve it.
